simple.meaning: חֲזוֹת (chăzôwth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a view.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Daniel 4:8. The surrounding context includes kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲזוֹת (H2379) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: חֲזוֹת (chăzôwth) / H2379 is traced through Daniel 4:8, Daniel 4:17 with generated occurrence evidence.
